definitions.name: S0B.PRESENT
definitions.note: Keep the present (non-NIL) elements of a Vector.

definitions.name: S0B.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 if empty).

definitions.name: S0B.GAPRUNS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 E SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Per element, the length of the run of NILs ending there (0 where present).

definitions.name: S0B.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String -> Vector of order Records.

definitions.name: S0B.COL
definitions.note: Vector of Records, key -> Vector of that key's values (NIL where missing).

definitions.name: S0B.REVENUE
definitions.body: S0B.ORDERS 'O' BIND O 'qty' S0B.COL O 'price' S0B.COL MUL S0B.PRESENT S0B.SUM
definitions.note: Total qty*price over priced orders, from JSON String.

definitions.name: S0B.QTYREC
definitions.body: S0B.ORDERS 'O' BIND O 'sku' S0B.COL O 'qty' S0B.COL GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Record sku -> summed qty, from JSON String.

definitions.name: S0B.WORDS
definitions.note: String -> Vector of lowercased words, ignoring extra spaces.

definitions.name: S0B.JOINSP
definitions.body: [ 'W' BIND W ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces.

definitions.name: S0B.CAP
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Uppercase the first character of a lowercase word.

definitions.name: S0B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record key with the largest value, first on ties.

solutions.sensor.present_mean: 'V' BIND V S0B.PRESENT 'P' BIND P S0B.SUM P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V S0B.PRESENT 0 GET 'F' BIND V F [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V S0B.PRESENT 'P' BIND V P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
solutions.orders.unpriced: S0B.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER 'sku' S0B.COL UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: S0B.ORDERS 'tags' S0B.COL S0B.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: S0B.WORDS [ S0B.CAP ] MAP S0B.JOINSP
